title: Publish a compatibility table for @kanbus/ui, @kanbus/api-client and @kanbus/cdk, and a kanbus-api version endpoint
description: Asked by the Chatticus session 2026-10-20, which now consumes all three packages. Today they version independently with no published compatibility guidance. Coupling: @kanbus/cdk bundles the kanbus-api server (cdk version = server version), @kanbus/api-client must match the server API, and @kanbus/ui is independent of the server. Work: (1) packages/README.md with a table of cdk version, bundled kanbus-api (Kanbus release), compatible api-client range, and notes, updated in each package release PR (add a CI check that a package version bump also updates the table). (2) GET /{tenant}/{project}/api/version (or an unauthenticated /api/version on the service API) returning the kanbus-api version and API revision, spec'd; api-client exposes getServerVersion() and documents the supported range. (3) Align the api-client issue and config types with @kanbus/ui's exported types, or document the mapping. Spec first; one way only.
